location: Burning west-rim cabin and shared sleeping area
time: World W3 at night; personal order 5; presented first as a cold open
scene_purpose: Promise immediate danger, establish that Moss outranks the structure and withhold only the rescue outcome.
entry_state: The cabin is already burning and the protagonist is below Moss’s sitting place.
reason_objective_matters: The relationship is the human stake and the opening must not imply a choice between life and property.
obstacle: Separated fire blocks cut the route while the wolf remains seated.
tactics: Ignore storage, empty water towards Moss and break the shortest wall route.
information_revealed: The protagonist spends no action defending possessions once Moss is threatened.
information_withheld: The fire’s cause, portal connection and Moss’s fate remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Panic to concentrated care, then interruption.
visual_event: Water passes a burning chest as Moss appears through flame.
turn: His hand reaches interaction distance and the film cuts.
outcome: The rescue remains unresolved but morally unambiguous.
exit_state: What caused the fire, and did he reach Moss in time?
story_value: Short reproducible fire stage, seated wolf line of sight, real water and breaking actions, and no claim that the outcome has been production-tested.

location: Ruined west-rim cabin and ravine overlook
time: World W5 near dusk; personal order 1
scene_purpose: Introduce the environmental authorship mystery without suggesting a visible intruder.
entry_state: The protagonist is on a solo expedition at the unexplored edge of his map.
objective: Cross the ravine before night and understand whether the ruin offers shelter.
reason_objective_matters: Its construction should not exist in a region he has never visited.
obstacle: The wooden upper cabin is gone, but player-made stone geometry and a descending stair remain.
opposing_agent: Persistent aftermath, fading light and the protagonist’s own knowledge of the save.
tactics: Check map context, read the foundation, inspect the protected chest recess and follow the stair.
information_revealed: The ruin was built efficiently around the same natural granite seam and stone rib.
information_withheld: It is his later work, Moss lived here and the portal waits below.
emotional_progression: Ordinary caution to unsettled recognition without an answer.
visual_event: A repeated overlook frames the L-shaped foundation and purple light under the ravine lip.
turn: The portal hum supplies a live route beneath a dead structure.
outcome: He descends rather than camping in the ruin.
exit_state: Why is an active portal connected to a cabin with no history?
setup_or_payoff: Grounds mystery in Minecraft construction and spatial persistence.
story_value: Burned cabin state, map-edge or coordinate context, reusable overlook, no body, no sign and no silhouette.

time: World W5 at dusk; personal order 1
scene_purpose: Pose the title question through block evidence and make entry an accountable decision.
entry_state: He expects the stair to lead to the ruin’s mine or cellar.
objective: Explain the active frame before choosing whether to cross.
reason_objective_matters: The portal is the only surviving system that may account for the impossible construction.
obstacle: A blast cavity, exposed lava, cobblestone foot and plank remnant show recent causality but no builder.
opposing_agent: The active frame and uncertain destination.
tactics: Inspect block faces, lava access, dark branch, frame economy and absence of recoverable drops.
information_revealed: The portal was physically constructed and activated near a recent explosion.
information_withheld: The protagonist built it after Moss’s death; fire rather than the explosion directly activated it.
visual_event: His hand rests on the water-cooled foot before moving into the portal plane.
turn: He enters when observation alone cannot answer the contradiction.
outcome: The known world gives way to temporal displacement.
exit_state: Where and when does this portal lead?
setup_or_payoff: Inciting agency and a dense but fair clue cluster.
story_value: Exact portal hero set, blast cavity, lava and plank continuity, controlled transition, and no unsupported explosion-to-fire implication.

location: Bare north-wall cave and pristine ravine
time: World W0 several days before W5; personal order 2
scene_purpose: Prove earlier time through missing construction and repeated natural geography.
entry_state: He expects a Nether arrival or another built exit.
objective: Determine location, time state and immediate survival options.
reason_objective_matters: Without orientation he cannot choose whether to wait, travel or reconstruct a route.
obstacle: The portal plane collapses to bare stone, evening approaches and the distant established base is unreachable before night.
tactics: Match the granite seam, stone rib, lava shelf and tree line; then secure the only flat ledge.
information_revealed: This is the same ravine before every player-placed block from the opening.
information_withheld: The exact interval, portal builder and future relationship remain unknown.
visual_event: The opening portal outline becomes bare rock in the same camera position.
turn: He chooses a temporary camp beside the evidence instead of a blind night journey.
exit_state: What will he build in the place whose ruin he already saw?
setup_or_payoff: Establishes the temporal rule through environment.
story_value: Pristine saved state, matched camera positions, day-night pressure and no second-avatar capture.

location: West-rim shelter, spruce terrain and cabin interior
time: World W0 through W1 across several in-game days; personal order 3
scene_purpose: Create an earned relationship and turn a temporary camp into the future home.
entry_state: The protagonist is alone, provisionally sheltered and still seeking a return route.
objective: Survive, tame Moss and establish a workable daily routine.
reason_objective_matters: The later loss needs lived attachment, and every future structure needs an ordinary origin.
obstacle: A skeleton, limited bones, building work, routine damage and the lava hazard complicate progress.
opposing_agent: Night mobs, resource scarcity and ordinary animal behaviour.
tactics: Defeat the skeleton, attempt taming, feed Moss, gather spruce, build around the wolf and use sit only before ravine mining.
information_revealed: Moss enters the story through normal play; the bedside wait and release-on-return pattern becomes habitual.
information_withheld: The routine will make self-evacuation impossible during the fire.
emotional_progression: Wariness to humour, trust and ease.
visual_event: Moss occupies a planned stair block, follows a timber run and later waits beside the bed until released.
turn: The protagonist stops calling the cabin temporary.
outcome: A stranded interval becomes a shared home.
exit_state: Why do parts of this new home feel familiar?
setup_or_payoff: Relationship, normality, geography and mechanical setup.
story_value: Real skeleton drop, taming attempts, feeding, follow and sit states, staged construction progress and no pen or doghouse.

location: Cabin foundation, stone chest recess and ravine overlook
time: World W2 in daylight; personal order 4
scene_purpose: Convert repeated environmental detail into recognition of the cabin’s future.
entry_state: He believes resemblance to the opening ruin may be incidental.
objective: Compare the finished build against remembered landmarks.
reason_objective_matters: If the ruin is this home, Moss is already inside a known danger pattern.
obstacle: Fire removed the opening cabin’s upper form, so proof depends on surviving stone geometry rather than exact decoration.
opposing_agent: Persistent blocks and the protagonist’s reluctance to accept the implication.
tactics: Align the granite notch, L-shaped footing, chest recess and stair rib from the opening viewpoint.
information_revealed: He has built the cabin whose burned remains preceded the portal.
information_withheld: The exact fire source, Moss’s fate and whether departure can avoid it remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Unease to dread, then active determination.
visual_event: A matched camera move turns the intact foundation into the remembered ruin without showing another person.
turn: He packs to leave with Moss at dawn and identifies lava as the most credible hazard.
exit_state: Can practical changes stop the remembered fire?
setup_or_payoff: Major recontextualisation through construction rather than exposition.
story_value: Coordinate-accurate foundation, granite, recess and stair matches with reversible intact and ruined states.

location: Cabin, ravine stair and lava-shelf approach
time: World W2 at dusk; personal order 4
scene_purpose: Give the protagonist a sensible prevention strategy and prepare the hidden flaw.
entry_state: He knows the cabin burns and intends to leave with Moss.
objective: Make the cabin safe for one final night, neutralise the lava and depart at dawn.
reason_objective_matters: Immediate night travel is dangerous, but waiting without changing the fire route would be passive.
obstacle: One stripped-spruce support remains behind the new stone cladding, and the return mechanism may require obsidian.
opposing_agent: Terrain, night pressure and incomplete visual access.
tactics: Pack supplies, replace exposed timber with stone, keep one water source ready and inspect the lava shelf.
information_revealed: He prioritises departure with Moss and does not plan to defend the cabin as property.
information_withheld: The cladding conceals a continuous flammable route and mining will expose lateral lava.
visual_event: Packed bundles sit beside the door while stone covers the visible stair and one log seam disappears behind it.
turn: He seats Moss beside the bed and descends for the final operation.
outcome: Is the apparent firebreak actually complete?
new_question: Agency, credible risk management and causal preparation.
setup_or_payoff: Readable shared sleeping area, packed-departure props, stone-cladding build, concealed-support cross-section and complete production blocking.

time: World W2 moving into W3 at night; personal order 4
scene_purpose: Turn prevention into the ordinary fire cause and source the portal materials.
entry_state: Moss is safely seated above, and the visible lava is covered by flowing water.
objective: Neutralise the shelf and collect enough obsidian for a possible controlled frame.
reason_objective_matters: Removing the hazard appears to protect Moss and preserve the only observed return technology.
obstacle: A second lava source lies behind the final cooled block and can flow laterally beyond the visible water.
opposing_agent: Fluid geometry, hidden timber and the protagonist’s dual objective.
tactics: Keep water on the exposed face, mine the obsidian and inspect the opening beneath it.
information_revealed: The cobblestone foot and obsidian used later have local origins; a side flow reaches the concealed support.
information_withheld: The protagonist does not yet know fire has already climbed behind him.
visual_event: Water hisses on the visible face while orange light disappears behind stone and reappears on timber above.
turn: Moss’s distress reveals that the fire has outrun his viewpoint.
exit_state: Can he reach the seated wolf before fire reaches the room?
setup_or_payoff: Physical causality, escalation and material provenance.
story_value: Target-version test for water direction, lava source placement, ignition range, fire tick timing and hidden-support visibility.

location: Burning cabin, shortest wall route and bedside sitting place
time: World W3 at night; personal order 5
scene_purpose: Complete the cold open, resolve Moss’s fate and avoid a false house-versus-wolf dilemma.
entry_state: The protagonist hears Moss while the fire moves through separated cabin blocks.
reason_objective_matters: The wolf is the only objective once danger is known.
obstacle: The protagonist begins below the cabin, one water source cannot suppress every fire block and Moss remains seated.
opposing_agent: Fire timing and trained animal state.
tactics: Ignore storage, place water towards the room, break the shortest wall and attempt the release interaction.
information_revealed: The sit routine prevents autonomous escape and the ruin is created by the same fire already observed.
information_withheld: The later portal decision and fatal ignition remain unknown.
emotional_progression: Urgency to hope at proximity, then grief.
visual_event: The cold-open reach continues one beat further; flame clears to the empty sitting position after death.
turn: The interaction comes after the terminal damage interval.
outcome: Moss is dead and the cabin is becoming the opening ruin.
exit_state: Will the protagonist accept the loss or use the remembered portal as another attempt?
story_value: Mechanically credible wolf position, visible prioritisation, controlled damage timing, no invented dropped collar and no claim of completed testing.

location: Burned cabin route, lava shelf and stored obsidian
time: World W3 late night; personal order 5
scene_purpose: Trace the disaster, connect it to the opening ruin and generate the final objective from grief.
entry_state: Moss is dead, the cabin cannot be recovered and the protagonist has survived with damaged equipment.
objective: Find the fire’s cause and any remaining route to a time before it.
reason_objective_matters: Causal knowledge is the only thing he can still act upon.
obstacle: The missing-block path implicates his own support and mining, while the standing portal from memory does not yet exist.
tactics: Follow the burn line, compare the surviving stone shell and gather the obsidian already mined.
information_revealed: The current ruin is the opening ruin, and he possesses the materials needed to become the portal builder.
information_withheld: The creeper, death and activation geometry remain unknown.
visual_event: The camera follows absent timber from Moss’s room to the lava shelf, then lands on ten obsidian blocks.
turn: He carries the obsidian to the bare portal outline.
exit_state: Can the remembered frame take him back before the fire?
setup_or_payoff: Causal recognition and launch of the final attempt.
story_value: Burned reset matching SC-02, legible missing-block route, ten sourced obsidian blocks and subdued gameplay pacing.

location: North-wall portal cave and dark lateral branch
time: World W4 before dawn; personal order 6
scene_purpose: Reveal the builder through action and make haste create lethal exposure.
entry_state: He has obsidian, one water bucket, local spruce, reduced health and no safe ignition tool.
objective: Build and activate the remembered portal immediately.
reason_objective_matters: He believes another crossing is the only remaining chance to reach Moss alive.
obstacle: The frame is inert, flint and spare iron were lost, rescue water removed a branch torch and a creeper can approach unseen.
opposing_agent: The grief-driven protagonist and the creeper’s ordinary hostile behaviour.
tactics: Copy the economical frame, recreate the foot, place a lava source and spruce cradle, then watch for fire.
information_revealed: He physically built every opening portal detail after Moss’s death.
information_withheld: The blast will enable rather than directly create the eventual fire inside the frame.
emotional_progression: Purpose to fragile hope, then fatal shock.
visual_event: The opening close-ups repeat in reverse until a hiss turns him from the still-dark frame.
turn: The creeper detonates at close range and kills him.
outcome: The builder is absent; the retaining lip is broken and the ignition geometry has changed.
exit_state: Will the blast extinguish the attempt or complete it?
setup_or_payoff: Builder confirmation, terminal reversal and blast-scar origin.
story_value: Exact block reconstruction, washed-torch continuity, controlled creeper approach, credible health and armour state, Hardcore death language and no simultaneous avatar.

time: World W4 immediately after death leading to W5 discovery; personal order closes
pov: Objective observer followed by the opening protagonist’s hand
scene_purpose: Resolve activation, absence and loop closure through one continuous environmental event.
entry_state: The protagonist is dead, the frame is intact and altered lava is reaching the surviving spruce.
objective: Complete the causal consequence of the ignition arrangement and reconnect it to the opening entry.
reason_objective_matters: Without activation, the portal discovery and entire personal journey cannot occur.
obstacle: Part of the cradle is gone, drops are exposed to lava or fire and flame must form inside the valid frame.
opposing_agent: Fluid and fire behaviour established by the protagonist’s prior placement.
tactics: Hold on the remaining plank, follow fire into the frame and match cut from activation to the earlier entry.
information_revealed: Ordinary fire, not the explosion itself, activates the portal; the opening frame is his failed return attempt.
information_withheld: The external first origin of temporal routing remains intentionally open.
emotional_progression: Shock to tragic recognition and reflective residue.
visual_event: Drops burn, the portal turns purple and the composition becomes the opening hand crossing.
turn: The physical effect shown first receives its final cause.
outcome: The protagonist’s worldline closes with no surviving builder or rescued wolf.
exit_state: Where did the temporal routing pattern first originate?
setup_or_payoff: Mystery closure, causal closure and final visual transformation.
story_value: Version-tested blast-to-lava-to-fire-to-portal chain, controllable item destruction, portal persistence and frame-accurate match cut.
